# JobFoundry

> Local-first, open-source infrastructure for job discovery, fit assessment, and truthful resume tailoring across 87 ATS and job boards.

JobFoundry pairs a privacy-first browser extension with a local backend server (SQLite, SimHash deduplication, LLM fit scoring, and LangGraph section-by-section tailoring) and a Kanban web UI. All candidate data and API keys remain strictly on the user's local machine.

## Core Documentation

- [Getting Started](https://jobfoundry.covai.org/docs/getting-started/): Installation options (Docker, AppImage, MSIX, Homebrew) and initial configuration.
- [Extension Guide](https://jobfoundry.covai.org/docs/extension/): Browser extension setup, zero-token ATS extraction, and local sync.
- [Architecture & Invariants](https://jobfoundry.covai.org/docs/architecture/): Local-first architecture, server-never-scrapes invariant, and task relay design.
- [Provider Directory](https://jobfoundry.covai.org/docs/providers/): Directory of 87 supported ATS and job board connectors.
- [API Keys & Providers](https://jobfoundry.covai.org/docs/api-keys/): Supported LLM providers (OpenRouter, OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama) and key isolation.
- [Privacy Policy](https://jobfoundry.covai.org/docs/privacy/): Local storage guarantees, zero telemetry, and API key confidentiality.
- [Manifesto](https://jobfoundry.covai.org/docs/manifesto/): Core project principles and ethical guidelines.
- [Support](https://jobfoundry.covai.org/docs/support/): Help, bug reporting, and private vulnerability disclosures.

## Developer & Contributor Guides

- [Adding a Provider](https://github.com/Covai-Labs/JobFoundry/blob/main/extension/src/background/providers/ADDING_A_PROVIDER.md): Step-by-step guide to writing a new ATS extractor.
- [Architecture Deep Dive](https://github.com/Covai-Labs/JobFoundry/blob/main/ARCHITECTURE.md): Service coordination, ports, and data pipelines.
- [Contributing](https://github.com/Covai-Labs/JobFoundry/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Code style, testing invariants, and development setup.
